contract.implementation: linked secp256k1::fast public returning APIs; exact source patches and library hash are in the external manifest; separate library translation units, no LTO required
contract.backend_metadata_scope: harness macros only; library flags and generated config require external build provenance
contract.timing_unit: full repeated jobs; region elapsed divided by arithmetic operations, not individual-call latency quantiles
contract.timed_costs: arithmetic API calls, assignment, loop/index/RHS loads, per-job seed reset, full final 32-byte serialization per lane, job call and compiler barrier
contract.untimed_costs: corpus generation, replay, checksum and byte checking, JSON, CPU endpoint and sysfs queries
contract.job_restart: every job restarts identical seeds and corpus; 1024 steps per lane
contract.verification: every job materializes all active output bytes; only last identical job per timed region byte-compared outside timing; lane-major actual-API replay is not an independent production arithmetic oracle
contract.inverse_dependency: result_dependent_lookup: index=(previous_result.limbs()[0]+step+lane)&255; invert nonzero corpus[index]; includes lookup/address dependency, avoids direct inv(inv(x)) two-cycle
contract.other_dependencies: add/sub/mul evolve state with rhs[(step+67*lane)&255]; square evolves state; chain1 or four interleaved independent states on one core
contract.scalar_square: Scalar operator*(a,a), no separate public square API
contract.threading: one caller thread; sequential dependency lanes are the measurement contract, not a parallel-work omission
contract.cpu_observation: sched_getcpu before/after each region only; equal endpoints do not prove no migration; power snapshots are endpoints, not average frequency
contract.calibration: one job initially; two consecutive regions meeting floor at same count; short resets streak and grows count ceil(1.5*target*jobs/elapsed), bounded by arithmetic cap and attempts; all evidence retained
contract.schedule: seeded Fisher-Yates base permutation; paired forward/reverse rotated orders; reverse-order reverses every schedule and calibration order, not input; not a full Latin square or statistical independence claim
contract.short_regions: all retained, never silently rerun or discarded; floor is qualification target not censoring rule
contract.scope_limits: not CT assurance, upper-layer speedup, independent kernel correctness proof, cross-backend comparison or discovery claim
contract.input_generation: SplitMix64; four 64-bit outputs encoded big-endian; strict canonical parse and nonzero rejection; field seed xor 0x6669656c645f7031, scalar seed xor 0x7363616c61725f31
